name: camera-scan
title_zh: 入住先扫一遍WiFi，把藏在局域网里的摄像头揪出来
tagline_zh: 酒店、民宿、短租房，你不知道墙里有没有眼睛。它不靠肉眼排查，直接探测网络设备、识别RTSP/DVR流。
tagline_en: Hotels, Airbnbs, rentals—unknown eyes may be watching. It probes your LAN, fingerprints RTSP/DVR streams, and.
desc_en: Detect hidden/networked surveillance cameras on the local WiFi/LAN — discover devices, fingerprint RTSP/DVR streams, identify the vendor, and pull live frames to see what each camera views. For hotels, Airbnbs, rentals you occupy.
why_zh: 不是物理扫描，而是从网络层主动出击：发现设备、指纹识别、拉流验证三步闭环。
why_en: Network-level detection, not guesswork: discover devices, fingerprint streams, pull live frames—see exactly what each camera.
limit_zh: 只覆盖同一WiFi/LAN下的网络摄像头；物理供电、无网卡或不在同一子网的偷拍设备测不到。需要你懂一点命令行。
limit_en: Only finds cameras on your current WiFi/LAN; battery-powered or off-network devices are invisible. Requires CLI comfort; pulling frames may trigger.
title_en: Scan local WiFi to find hidden cameras before you settle in
